Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! Chamari Atapattu and Vishmi Gunaratne are the openers. Renuka Singh has the new ball in hand. Here we go...
... RUN CHASE ...

Now, the target is a big one. Sri Lanka haven’t been at their best with the bat so far and will need someone to play a special knock if they are to chase this down. India on the other hand, will back themselves to defend this total and whitewash this series. Stay tuned as we look forward to the second innings in a short while.

The Lankan bowlers gave away plenty at the start. They did well to pull things back courtesy of their spinners. They will be however very disappointed with the fielding which in the end could cost them the game. Every bowler that bowled contributed with at least one wicket but would have hoped that they could have been more disciplined.

The start though was really good for the visitors. Smriti Mandhana fell early but Shafali Verma and Yastika Bhatia put up a really good partnership. Once Bhatia fell, the away side lost wickets in heaps. They were struggling at 124 for 6. They could have been 7 down had Pooja Vastrakar's catch been taken. She made most of her life though and along with Harmanpreet Kaur almost put up a 100-run stand. Both scored half-centuries. Pooja Vastrakar though stayed there till the end to ensure India get over the 250-run mark.

India have recovered brilliantly and have gotten themselves a score that they will feel is above par. Credit to Harmanpreet Kaur and Pooja Vastrakar as the partnership between the two was the highlight of the game and courtesy of them, India will be very happy with where they are in the game at the moment.

FOUR! Aerial from Shafali Verma as she charges down the pitch. Full and outside off and Shafali Verma reaches for the ball and thumps it over covers for a one-bounce boundary!
Ama Kanchana goes full once again on the legs, Smriti Mandhana plays this through mid-wicket and gets a run.
Full and on the pads, Shafali Verma works this easily through mid-wicket for a single.
Full once again outside off, Shafali Verma mistimes this back to the bowler.
Slightly short outside off, played towards point.
Shafali Verma comes down the wicket and takes the delivery on the full outside off. Thumps it towards covers and does not run for the misfield.
Not a good sign! The groundstaff are gathering near the boundary lines which means rain is expected.
Shafali Verma moves around in her crease and works short delivery outside off towards long on for a single.
Full on off stump, Smriti Mandhana knocks this towards mid off for a single.
Flighted wide outside off, Smriti Mandhana leaves this one alone.
Short and on off, Smriti Mandhana plays this towards point.
Good delivery! Tossed up outside off, beats Smriti Mandhana on the outside edge.
Slightly short outside off, Worked towards point.
On off, this is pushed to mid off.
A huge appeal for a caught behind but turned down! Fuller and on off, this one shapes away. Verma looks to drive but is beaten.
FOUR! Make that two in a row now! Whipped away. On middle, Verma works it wide of mid on and this races away. She continues from where she left off in the last game.
FOUR! Put away! Short and wide outside off, Verma guides it past point and this one races away to the fence.
On the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
We'll fielded! Fuller and on off, this is driven hard to the right of the fielder at cover. She dives and makes. A half stop. A single.
Full and angled into the pads, Shafali Verma flicks this towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full length on middle, driven down the ground for a single.
Full, and Smriti Mandhana defends this solidly towards the off side.
Flighted full outside off, fended firmly to the offside.
Slightly back of a length and outside off, Smriti Mandhana stays back and knocks this on the offside.
Pitched full outside off. Worked towards cover.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings! Ama Kanchana goes full on the pads, Shafali Verma plays this  through mid-wicket and a misfield gives her four runs.
Goes fraction short and wide from off stump. Shafali Verma mistimes this towards cover.
Full once again and bowled outside off, Shafali Verma fends this towards point.
Full and outside off, slower in the air, and Shafali Verma knocks this towards covers.
Full length outside off, driven to point.

Harmanpreet Kaur says they wanted to bowl but they need to prepare for both. States they have done well and they back themselves. Informs they are playing the same team and they are looking forward to this game. Ends by saying the wicket might start turning later on and they need to put up a good total on the board.
We are all set for the game. Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana stride towards the pitch. Ama Kanchana will begin proceedings with the new ball.
Ama Kanchana begins with a ball angled into the pads, Shafali Verma works this towards mid-wicket for a brace.

Chamari Atapattu says batting first did not work and hence, they want to bowl. Informs they have one change. Reckons it is a good wicket but the first 10 overs could be important. Ends by saying India has batted well and they’ll try their best today.

The pitch looks similar to the one that was played on in the last game. It seems there is not much life left in the pitch and there is less grass as well. There may be a lot of help for the spinners and there will also be some movement in the air for the pacers. Overall though a good batting wicket and teams would look to bat first.

India Women (Playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Smriti Mandhana, Yastika Bhatia (WK), Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Harleen Deol, Deepti Sharma, Richa Ghosh, Pooja Vastrakar, Renuka Singh, Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Meghna Singh.

Sri Lanka Women (Playing XI) - Chamari Atapattu (C), Vishmi Gunaratne, Hasini Perera, Harshitha Madavi, Kavisha Dilhari, Nilakshi de Silva, Anushka Sanjeewani (WK), Oshadi Ranasinghe, Rashmi de Silva, Ama Kanchana, Inoka Ranaweera.
Sri Lanka have won the toss and they will have a bowl first.

With the series in the bag, India will be eager to complete the whitewash! They failed to do so in the T20I series but will want to do it here. Sri Lanka on the other hand will want to end the series on a high. Can they put up a better performance? Can they give this Indian side a run for their money? We will find out soon.
